title: time-weighted bid stabilizer and GPU-shape pacing for spot/on-demand routing
creator: Laura Chen
description: Implement a time-weighted bid stabilization and GPU-shape pacing layer to reduce oscillation between spot and on-demand routing, enforce per-customer budget caps smoothly, and reduce costly emergency fallbacks. The feature aims to: 1) minimize repeated re-routing churn when spot pools briefly degrade, 2) respect short-term spend caps while preserving latency SLOs, and 3) enable soft GPU-shape preferences (e.g., prefer A100 but allow T4 fallback with controlled penalty).
acceptance_criteria: 1) End-to-end config exists for per-customer time-windowed spend pacing with a user-visible field 'pacing_window' and 'max_window_burn' in the routing policy. 2) Routing decision logs include bid_stabilizer_score and gpu_penalty used. 3) Experiments show <15% increase in p99 latency and >=20% reduction in emergency on-demand switches vs baseline during spot churn. 4) Unit + integration tests added. 5) Feature flag gated and rollout plan documented.
technical_notes: Design summary: - Maintain an exponential moving average (EMA) of spend and spot success rate per customer-region-tier with configurable half-life. - Compute time-weighted bid_stabilizer_score = base_score * exp(-alpha * recent_spend_burn_ratio) * (1 + spot_failure_penalty). - GPU-shape preference implemented as soft penalties: penalty(shape) = lambda_shape * shape_cost_delta / median_cost. Shapes with higher penalty are deprioritized but considered if bid_stabilizer_score + (1/latency_headroom) still meets SLO. - Budget caps enforced by 'pacing budget guard' which returns a throttled_weight in [0,1] applied to candidate scores to avoid immediate hard rejection; this enables graceful degradation. - Add short-circuit fallback: if KV cache hit ratio >= threshold and candidate model smaller variant available, prefer model variant to avoid expensive GPU upgrade. - Telemetry: expose metrics spend_ema, spot_failure_rate_ema, bid_stabilizer_score, gpu_penalty, pacing_throttle_ratio, emergency_switch_count.
implementation_steps: 1) Add per-customer EMA counters and storage schema in routing state service. 2) Implement stabilizer function in policy evaluator with unit tests. 3) Add GPU penalty table and config UI mapping (console + API). 4) Wire pacing_throttle_ratio into scoring pipeline. 5) Backend e2e tests with simulated spot churn (local chaos harness). 6) Canary rollout behind feature flag with 5% traffic. 7) Monitor metrics and iterate.
rollout_plan: - Feature flag off by default. - Stage 1 (dev): link unit tests and integration tests (branch: feature/ENG-76521-bid-stabilizer). - Stage 2 (staging): enable for internal customers and run 48h synthetic churn test. - Stage 3 (canary): 5% of production traffic for low-risk tenants. Monitor: p99 latency, emergency_switch_count, budget_burn_rate. - Stage 4: progressive ramp to 50% then 100% if metrics stable for 72h. - Rollback: toggle feature flag off; policy evaluator reverts to legacy scoring immediately.
metrics_to_track: - p50/p95/p99 latency by tenant tier, - emergency_on-demand_switches per hour, - spot_eviction_rate observed by router, - average spend_burn_ratio over pacing_window, - number of re-routes per request (should decrease), - throttled_request_fraction.
open_risks_and_mitigation: 1) Risk: Overly aggressive pacing might starve high-priority tenants -> Mitigation: honor tier override and require manual opt-in for critical SLAs. 2) Risk: EMA hysteresis could delay recovery -> Mitigation: expose EMA half-life and allow faster decay during calm periods. 3) Risk: Complexity in GPU penalty tuning -> Mitigation: auto-calibrate lambda_shape from historical cost/latency tradeoffs and expose override per-tenant.
testing_plan: - Unit tests for stabilizer math and GPU penalty. - Integration tests with routing simulator to replay 7-day trace and measure oscillation. - Chaos test: inject spot eviction spikes and validate emergency_switch_count reduction. - Load test: ensure no routing hotpath latency regression >10%. - Manual QA steps documented in QA_notes.
QA_notes: Steps to validate in staging: 1) Enable feature flag for test tenant T-ROUTER-01. 2) Run synthetic spot-eviction script from infra/chaos and observe routing logs include bid_stabilizer_score. 3) Verify throttle_ratio reduces slot allocation gracefully without hard 429s. 4) Validate metrics pipeline emits spend_ema and pacing_throttle_ratio to console dashboards.
